description: Q25022 locus assignment: identity margin, substitution distribution, and resistance-codon states
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os, json, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
OUT=os.getcwd()
R=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"Q25022_alignment_table_WBPS19.tsv"),sep="\t")
D=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"Q25022_substitution_lists.json")))

label={"HCON_00043670":"HCON_00043670  chr II 13.43 Mb\nisotype-2 (tbb-isotype-2)",
       "HCON_00005260":"HCON_00005260  chr I 7.03 Mb\nisotype-1 (BZ-selected locus)",
       "HCON_00164580":"HCON_00164580  chr X 1.27 Mb\ntbb-isotype-4",
       "HCON_00167340":"HCON_00167340  chr X 5.61 Mb\ntbb-isotype-3"}
sub=R[R.gene.isin(label)].copy().sort_values("pid_vs_Q25022",ascending=True)
sub["lab"]=sub.gene.map(label)

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,8.6))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1.08],width_ratios=[1.25,1],hspace=0.42,wspace=0.30)

# ---- A: identity bars
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
cols=["#9aa5b1" if g!="HCON_00043670" else "#2f6f4e" for g in sub.gene]
b=ax.barh(sub.lab,sub.pid_vs_Q25022,color=cols,height=0.62)
for y,(p,d) in enumerate(zip(sub.pid_vs_Q25022,sub.aa_differences)):
    ax.text(p+0.12,y,f"{p:.2f} %  ({d} aa differences)",va="center",fontsize=10.5)
ax.set_xlim(85,101.6); ax.set_xlabel("identity to Q25022 (global BLOSUM62 alignment, % of 448 query residues)")
ax.set_title("Q25022 (beta 12-16 cDNA, Geary 1992) against every beta-tubulin gene model\n"
             "in the H. contortus chromosome-scale assembly PRJEB506 (WBPS19)",fontsize=12.5,loc="left")
ax.annotate("", xy=(99.55,3), xytext=(94.20,3), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->",color="#b3453a",lw=1.6))
ax.text(96.9,3.30,"margin over runner-up\n5.35 percentage points,\n2 vs 26 differences",
        ha="center",fontsize=10,color="#b3453a")
ax.grid(axis="x",alpha=0.3); ax.set_axisbelow(True)
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# ---- B: substitution positions along the protein
ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
def positions(key):
    return [int(re.findall(r"\d+",s)[0]) for s in D[key]]
tracks=[("vs HCON_00043670 (isotype-2)","PRJEB506|HCON_00043670","#2f6f4e"),
        ("vs HCON_00005260 (isotype-1)","PRJEB506|HCON_00005260","#9aa5b1"),
        ("vs Q25024 tub8-9 cDNA","UniProt|Q25024 tub8-9 cDNA","#9aa5b1"),
        ("vs A2TF56 isotype-1 BZ-R","UniProt|A2TF56 resistant-isolate isotype-1 cDNA","#9aa5b1")]
for i,(nm,k,c) in enumerate(tracks):
    y=len(tracks)-1-i
    ax2.add_patch(Rectangle((1,y-0.16),448,0.32,facecolor="#eef1f4",edgecolor="none"))
    for p in positions(k): ax2.plot([p,p],[y-0.22,y+0.22],color=c,lw=1.5)
    ax2.text(455,y,f"{len(positions(k))}",va="center",fontsize=10,color=c if c!="#9aa5b1" else "#5a646e")
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(tracks))); ax2.set_yticklabels([t[0] for t in reversed(tracks)],fontsize=9.5)
for p,txt in [(167,"167"),(198,"198"),(200,"200")]:
    ax2.axvline(p,color="#b3453a",ls=":",lw=1.1)
ax2.text(188,3.65,"BZ-resistance codons 167 / 198 / 200",color="#b3453a",fontsize=9.5,ha="center")
ax2.set_xlim(-8,498); ax2.set_ylim(-0.6,3.95)
ax2.set_xlabel("residue position in Q25022 (448 aa)")
ax2.set_title("where the amino-acid differences sit",fontsize=11,loc="left")
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax2.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# ---- C: residue state table
ax3=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1]); ax3.axis("off")
tab=[["sequence","167","198","200","assignment"],
     ["Q25022  beta 12-16","F","E","F","isotype-2"],
     ["HCON_00043670 (chr II)","F","E","F","isotype-2"],
     ["HCON_00005260 (chr I)","F","E","F","isotype-1"],
     ["A2TF56  EF198865 isotype-1","F","E","Y","isotype-1"],
     ["C5J0J0  FJ981633 'isotype 1'","F","E","F","isotype-1"],
     ["C5J0J6  FJ981640 'isotype 2'","F","E","F","isotype-2"],
     ["HCON_00164580 (chr X)","F","E","F","tbb-isotype-4"],
     ["HCON_00167340 (chr X)","F","E","F","tbb-isotype-3"]]
t=ax3.table(cellText=tab[1:],colLabels=tab[0],loc="center",cellLoc="center")
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(8.6); t.scale(1,1.42)
for (r_,c_),cell in t.get_celld().items():
    cell.set_edgecolor("#d6dbe0")
    if r_==0: cell.set_facecolor("#eef1f4"); cell.set_text_props(weight="bold")
    if c_==0: cell.set_text_props(ha="left")
    if r_ in (1,2): cell.set_facecolor("#e6f0ea")
    if r_==4 and c_==3: cell.set_facecolor("#f6ded9")
ax3.set_title("state at the three canonical benzimidazole-resistance codons",fontsize=11,loc="left")
plt.show()
